scope: Low-temperature gas identity, source provenance and coverage audit. P4O6 choice is retained from the preceding review; no production dataset or source coefficients are changed.

validity.physical_validation: Not established across either interval. Bounds describe representations of thermochemical models, not measurements throughout the range.
validity.source_error_model: Reported +/- estimates and intermethod spreads are not calibrated probability distributions. No covariance model is supplied.

H3PO4.identity: gas O=P(OH)3, not liquid/solid phosphoric acid
H3PO4.thermal_function_evidence: Burcat record supplies computed frequencies and three estimated OH torsional barriers, 1200,1200,1450 cm^-1. The reported Cp fit residual 0.17% at 400 K measures polynomial fitting, not physical model accuracy.

alternatives.inspection: Numerical value -272.41 kcal/mol directly inspected in Burcat comment; primary paper numerical table not inspected.
Primary author manuscript section II.D inspected; liquid Hf plus COSMO-RS vaporization estimate, not a gas measurement.
Value quoted by Saab2017; original and erratum numerical contents not inspected; not eligible as a calibrated reference.

H3PO4.decision: Keep selected research anchor explicit and run controlled alternatives. Independent calculations support an approximately 8-23 kJ/mol source spread, not an established best value. Do not interpret +/-2.90 of the liquid-derived estimate as total gas uncertainty.

HPO2.identity: gas HOPO; GGChem/NASA9 HPO2 and newer NASA7 HOPO refer to the same species

uncertainty_annotations.resolution: Annotation discrepancy preserved; do not choose the smaller value as a validated error bar.

HPO2.thermal_function_evidence: Burcat computed frequencies and an estimated 2000 cm^-1 OH torsional barrier; NASA7 Cp fit residual 0.30% at 400 K. These do not independently validate entropy.

alternatives.inspection: Alternative -106.2 +/-2 kcal/mol inspected in Burcat comments.
Publisher-deposited abstract inspected via Crossref; -110.6 kcal/mol, third-law analysis of measured gas equilibria. Full paper uncertainty and temperature range not inspected.

HPO2.decision: Independent equilibrium experiment is much closer to the selected Haworth anchor than the unused G3B3 alternative. The +24.2672 kJ/mol G3B3 offset is a source stress test, not a symmetric uncertainty or a recommended replacement.

alternatives.inspection: Alternative -165.4 kcal/mol inspected in Burcat comments.
Publisher-deposited abstract inspected via Crossref; -168.8 kcal/mol. Full paper uncertainty not inspected.

H3PO3_phosphonic.limitation: No uncertainty assigned from a different isomer.

HPO.identity: gas HPO; existing CEA anchor is not the Burcat/Haworth anchor
HPO.decision: Unresolved disagreement; do not silently swap source or interpret full source agreement as established.

PH3.decision: Keep the measured-data-derived CEA choice explicit. Burcat G3B3 availability is not a reason to replace every selected P species.

P4S3.availability: Absent from both pinned NASA9 source files; represented in native GGChem comparison. This remains a separate network coverage gap.

HPO4.identity: Neutral HPO4, labelled phosphoric acid biradical in the source; candidate for numerical coverage only.
HPO4.source_annotation: The NASA7 comment states SIGMA=1 and STATWT=2 for neutral HPO4 (48 electrons).
HPO4.inspection: Directly inspected in results/p4o9_audit/BURCAT.THR.txt, lines 32726-32729; the matching pinned NASA9 candidate is at source line 21699.
HPO4.limitation: The original electronic-state calculation and meaning of the statistical-weight annotation were not recovered. The even-electron composition makes this annotation a data-quality question requiring review, not a verified physical electronic-state assignment.
HPO4.decision: Retain the original record only for the declared finite-catalog sensitivity test; do not interpret identity-reviewed candidates as physically vetted thermochemistry or silently correct the entropy.

sources.citation: Elke Goos G3B3 Stuttgart, as attributed by the H3PO4/H3PO3 Burcat records
sources.inspection: Database comments and coefficients inspected; a separate original computational report with reproducible raw output was not recovered.

sources.citation: Burcat G3B3 calculations as attributed in individual records
sources.inspection: Database primary record inspected; original calculation files not recovered.

sources.citation: Heats of formation of phosphorus compounds determined by current methods of computational quantum chemistry, JCP117,11175-11187
sources.inspection: Bibliographic identity and database quotation verified; original numerical tables and complete uncertainty derivation not inspected.

sources.citation: Quantum Chemical Study of the Thermochemical Properties of Organophosphorous Compounds
sources.inspection: Publisher supporting information PDF/XLSX inspected; CBS-QB3 method, atomic reference choices, geometries and group-additivity material available. Main numerical H3PO4 table not recovered.
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 as stated by ACS Figshare metadata

sources.citation: Thermochemical properties of gaseous POBr and some H-P-O species, JCP100,8373-8376
sources.inspection: Publisher-deposited abstract inspected via https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1063/1.466782; full paper not recovered.
sources.method: Effusion beams from reaction of H2O or Br2 with Ca2P2O7, mass-spectral species identification and third-law analysis of reaction equilibria.
sources.limitation: Do not infer error bars or a verified cold measurement range from this abstract.

sources.citation: Facing the challenge of predicting the standard formation enthalpies of n-butyl-phosphate species with ab initio methods
sources.inspection: Primary author manuscript, Table I, Table III, section II.D and bibliography inspected.
sources.finding: No experimental gas-phase H3PO4 formation enthalpy reported there. Adds COSMO-RS vaporization 144.7 kJ/mol to liquid -1271.66 +/-2.90. Table III validation errors are 6.5,5.2 and21 kJ/mol for butanol, water and TBP respectively; these are not H3PO4-specific bounds.

sources.citation: Accurate heats of formation and acidities for H3PO4, H2SO4, and H2CO3 from ab initio electronic structure calculations
sources.inspection: Original bibliographic/method information verified; -1141.4 kJ/mol quoted in Saab2017. Erratum existence independently verified via publisher-deposited Crossref metadata, but corrected tables not inspected.
Condensed-phase thermochemistry and gas acidity are available; no neutral gas formation enthalpy benchmark identified. Gas acidity is not a substitute for neutral gas Hf.

sources.finding: Uses NASA/Burcat for consistency with prior atmosphere models; this is shared source ancestry, not independent validation of H3PO4/HOPO thermal functions. The independent G4 P4O6 calculation is covered in the earlier source review.

excluded_isotope.PT: Tritium phosphorous; source H3 denotes isotope mass, not three H atoms.

coverage.meaning: 29 available additional gas identities, not proof of chemical completeness. Isomers retain independent records.

representation_checks.description: Same chemical identities, unchanged anchors; differences reflect NASA7/NASA9 fit representations and rounded GGChem atom-subtracted coefficients. Fit bounds are not physical validation.

open_validation_items: Recover Haworth/Bacskay original numerical tables and uncertainty definitions.
Recover Alexeev2005 original and erratum before treating its H3PO4 value as a reference.
Resolve H3PO4 thermal-function uncertainty from low-frequency torsions and conformers, beyond formation enthalpy shifts.
Treat condensates, aqueous chemistry and missing P4S3 separately from gas-network closure.
Investigate HPO anchor disagreement if it influences an intended application.
policy: Preserve source identity per species and allow explicit research alternatives. No blanket switch to Burcat is justified. Current H3PO4/HOPO availability improves a declared gas network but does not justify a validated low-temperature production preset.
